title: Annotatio V §.II close: Luther agrees (Postilla; Jn 6; Neodorpius) — stop before §.III
pass_a_gloss: Luther agrees with Augustine in various places of his Ecclesiastical Postil, the Sermon on the Septuagesima Sunday Epistle and on the Gospel of the feast of Christ’s Body, and on John ch. 6. See Neodorpius’s Orthodox Luther from p. 120.
pass_b_english: §.II close: Luther agrees with Augustine in the Ecclesiastical Postil, Septuagesima / Corpus Christi sermons, and on John 6 — see Neodorpius, Orthodox Luther from p. 120.
Stop before §.III (Lutheran double corporal eating / oral restriction).
source_text: Augustino adstipulatur Lutherus variis in locis Postillæ suæ Ecclesiasticæ, Concione in Epist. Dominicalem Septuagesima & in Evangelium festi Corporis Christi, in cap. 6 Johan. Vide Neodorpii Lutherum Orthodoxum à pag. 120.
